remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST due by Monday 10/28 at 5:00 PM Don't miss this renovated, in town Colonial that's only steps from Mead Park, the train and New Canaan's charming village! The gourmet kitchen includes a new Bertazzoni Induction Range, Whirlpool Refrigerator and a walk-in pantry. In addition, there's a cozy family room with new carpeting and a wood burning fireplace that's right next to the kitchen. The second floor includes a primary suite with his and her walk-in closets, a gas fireplace and a laundry room. Outside, there's a new construction garage with 432 square feet of additional room, a freshly repaved driveway and a new patio with landscaping. Welcome to the neighborhood!
